react.description: Wraps one trigger element and renders a `div[role=tooltip][popover=manual]` after it. Hover (with delays), keyboard focus and a touch long press open it; Escape, blur and leaving close it. The tooltip itself is hoverable.

props.description: Draws an arrow pointing at the trigger.
props.name: arrow

props.description: One element that takes focus and pointer events (a button, a link, a focusable span).
props.name: children

props.description: The tooltip describes its trigger (`aria-describedby`) instead of naming it (`aria-labelledby`, the default: use it for icon-only buttons).
props.name: describeChild

props.description: Doesn't show the tooltip on focus.
props.name: disableFocusListener

props.description: Doesn't show the tooltip on hover.
props.name: disableHoverListener

props.description: Doesn't show the tooltip on a long press.
props.name: disableTouchListener

props.description: Milliseconds before it opens while another tooltip shows or closed less than 800 ms ago, so moving along a toolbar shows the next tooltip sooner.
props.name: enterNextDelay

props.description: Default 700 ms (touch: a long press opens the tooltip).
props.name: enterTouchDelay

props.description: The tooltip follows the pointer while it is over the trigger.
props.name: followCursor

props.description: Called when the tooltip shows or hides.
props.name: onOpenChange

props.description: Side of the trigger and alignment.
props.name: placement

props.description: The text. An empty title renders no tooltip.
props.name: title
